validity.researcher_notes: PROJECT EXISTS: Supply Header Project is a real, certificated expansion of Atlantic Coast Pipeline (docket CP15-555, Dominion Energy Transmission Co). Associated with main ACP pipeline cancelled July 2020. CONCERNS: (1) Sheet shows Status=cancelled, CancelledYear=2020, StartYear1=2021 - inconsistent. EIA data shows Construction 2018-05 through 2023-01, then On Hold 2023-04 through 2023-10, finally Cancelled starting 2025-01. (2) StartYear1=2021 appears incorrect - this was not an in-service year. (3) The sheet's cancelled status is correct (project never operated) but CancelledYear needs verification - was certificate formally withdrawn in 2020 or later? CNN 2020-07-05 reports ACP mainline cancelled; Supply Header construction 'voluntarily stopped' per EIA notes but formal cancellation date needs FERC documentation. LOCATION: Route confirmed via geojson: starts Westmoreland County PA (40.46°N, 79.64°W), ends north-central WV (39.17°N, 80.56°W). SPECS VERIFIED: Length 38 mi = 61.2 km (matches sheet); Capacity 1500 MMcf/d (matches sheet); Diameter 30,36 in (matches sheet) per EIA CP15-555 records.
